scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bff,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/bff" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:en: concurrently -k -n bff,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/bff" "npm run dev:en -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/bff && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n bff,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w apps/bff" "npm run serve:ssr -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/bff && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/bff && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run docs:check
